name: Wildfire
author: Erin Carter
description: A fire season seen from a night satellite: dark FBM terrain carrying two or three closed irregular ember rings at staggered ages, each an expanding conversion front graded warm-to-cool across its narrow stroke with hot knots strung along it. Interiors stay burned and pricked by cooling sparks; perimeters only grow, a fresh ring always kindling while an old one is still mid-frame.

params.label: Spread rate
params.effect: How fast each perimeter dilates outward.

params.label: Line width
params.effect: Stroke width in CSS pixels of the glowing perimeter lines.

params.label: Knot intensity
params.effect: Brightness boost of the hot knots strung along the lines; zero evens the perimeters out.

params.label: Terrain drag
params.effect: How strongly the unseen terrain distorts the rings; zero spreads them as clean circles.
